author: Guerrilla Miniature Games
description:
We're back with The Indie Hour Episode Sixty-Six! This series focuses on games you may have never even heard of and gives us an inside look at the wider world of independantly published Tabletop Wargames of all genres.

Have you ever thought about leaving it all behind for a tiny hamlet in the woods? Just you, your pet toad, some weird cauldron ingredients and the urge to hex your enemies and see them suffer? The Witches (or Warlock's life) might be for you. Let's check it out!

Check out the rules  HERE : https://www.wargamevault.com/en/product/547978/hag28-fantasy-skirmish?affiliate_id=210041
title: The GMG Indie Hour Ep 066 - HAG28 by  T.M. Cibelius
